column1: # One group of equivalent terms per line; members separated by TABs (commas
# also work). Lines starting with # are comments. Members may be several
# words ("one shot", "bass drum"): they match as an exact phrase. Matching
# is case- and accent-insensitive and goes through the same analysis as
# file names, so "Hi-Hat" and "hi hat" are the same member; plurals are
# folded already (kick = kicks), do not list them.
# Expansion happens at query time: editing this file needs no reindex.
# Override for one machine: copy it to <SONAR_HOME>/synonyms.tsv
# Keep groups honest: a wrong synonym costs precision on every search that
# uses it. Only true equivalents in sample-library naming; no "related"
# sounds (crash != ride, sub != bass, keys != piano, hit != impact).
# "OH"/"CH" are the standard drum-machine abbreviations (909 OH, CH 01).
